title: behalf v1 Action Receipt (producer envelope)
description: The DSSE-signed receipt payload: everything the capture surface asserts, and the bytes the log leaf hashes. Ingest-assigned fields (seq, inclusion proofs, checkpoint membership, checkpoint_id) are NOT modelled here — they live in the log structure and the index projection, never inside the signed receipt. See the receipt schema v1 documentation for field-by-field rationale.

schema_version.description: Read-path projection key; verbatim bytes are never rewritten.

otel_conventions_version.description: gen_ai.* conventions version in force at capture; lets old records be re-normalised when the still-Development conventions move. Capture-only, unbackfillable.

receipt_id.description: Client-minted ULID; the idempotency key, minted at capture so a retried send can never occupy two chain positions.

kind.description: Closed vendor enum; customer vocabulary rides kind_ext.

risk_class.description: Assigned by the proxy's capture-time tool-policy config, not producer-self-reported.

risk_policy_digest.description: Digest of the policy that assigned risk_class, so the assignment is auditable. Capture-only.

captured_at.description: Capture-surface timestamp, asserted; hardened clock trust is a later milestone.

emitter.description: The capture surface that produced this evidence, distinct from the actor.

jkt.description: Surface's own Ed25519 key thumbprint, generated at install, distinct from any human device key; signs the DSSE envelope.

surface.description: The MCP proxy is the canonical v1 surface; Claude Code hooks and the behalf CLI are companion surfaces.

counter.description: Per-emitter monotonic counter stamped before spooling so pre-append loss/reordering is detectable. Capture-only integrity primitive.

actor.description: Who acted, if distinct from emitter. Optional.

jkt.description: Canonical actor identity is the key thumbprint — keys are what the cryptography proves.

labels.description: clientInfo / hook agent_id / MCP server name — stored verbatim as asserted labels, never used for security decisions.

emitter_to_actor.description: The emitter-to-actor assertion is recorded but never enforced.

outcome.description: Result or failure; covers failure of the attempted operation.

idempotency_key.description: The target operation's idempotency key, distinct from receipt_id.

attempt.description: Intent spooled before forwarding, merged into the completion receipt in the common case; flushed as orphan_intent on crash.

intent_digest.description: Spooled intent digest; also the anchor for denial/delegation_failed records. Capture-only; the crash-between hole cannot be backfilled.

run_id.description: Reconstruction grouping key by normative precedence: caller-supplied -> hook session/agent id -> root trace_id -> proxy-process session. Required at ingest; the other five correlation keys are not.

run_id_provenance.description: Which precedence rung produced run_id, so grouping is honest about its own provenance. Capture-only.

correlation.description: The other five of the six correlation keys — all indexed, none required at ingest.

step_key.description: Hash of (tool name, normalized argument schema, causal ordinal); reserved and populated from record one so run comparison works on day-one data. Records written without it cannot be aligned retroactively. Capture-only.

authority.description: The delegation chain: the attenuating-agent-token JWS chain embedded whole, whose par_hash linkage is the DAG edge.

attribution.description: Two orthogonal axes, stored at write, never derived at query time.

verification.description: Receipt-level rollup = weakest hop; three states, not two.

class.description: Derived from token-path evidence at write; a linked approval never reclassifies.

payload.description: Payload slots; customer-held everywhere, behalf holds digests/refs only.

model_call.description: Reserved context class: a customer-held payload artifact referenced by digest, populated when the in-process SDK surface arrives.

human_in_loop.description: Consent/denial, marked asserted — a click is not cryptography.

provenance.description: Native vs imported; an import carries an asserted floor no later operation can raise.

import_floor.description: Required on imported records; travels in every rendering and proof.

links.description: Typed references carrying the target's log index + leaf hash.

anchor.description: For denial/delegation_failed with no action to point at: anchor to the token jti/par_hash + intent digest.

raw_frame_ref.description: Digest of the raw source event (hook JSON, MCP message), optionally retained customer-side for re-normalisation when conventions move.

allOf.$comment: Imported records must declare the asserted floor.
Orphan-intent records carry the spooled intent digest.

hop.description: One delegation hop: the attenuating-agent-token draft field set verbatim plus one named behalf extension, the root principal binding.

authorization_details.description: RFC 9396 raw per-hop grant, captured verbatim; the attenuation delta is recomputed at read from these raw inputs, never frozen.

exp.description: Per-hop expiry, verbatim; half of the revocation-window join.

jti.description: Per-hop token id, required by the attenuating-agent-token draft (§3.2); a hop without it is denied (§7). Unbackfillable.

credential.description: Canonical credential reference — namespaced ids, never the token.

kind.description: Namespaced credential mechanism, e.g. oauth-jti, id-jag, svid-serial.

auth_time.description: Where the exchange exposes it, e.g. an identity-assertion authorization grant.

root_principal_binding.description: behalf extension at depth 0: OIDC nonce == jkt(device_pubkey).

id_token_ref.description: Digest of the customer-held ID-token blob.

trigger.description: Autonomous depth-0 root: installing operator's device key carrying a trigger claim, honestly asserted.

carriage_route.description: How the hop arrived (in-band signatures vs out-of-band sh.behalf/chain over MCP); metadata, since verification comes from the signatures.

attenuation_flag.description: Non-comparable vocabularies yield 'unknown', recorded and flagged, never swallowed.

payload_slot.description: One payload availability slot; a slot full of placeholders is still verifiable evidence.

digest.description: Plain SHA-256 over raw plaintext bytes; commitment and content-addressed-storage address are one value.

custody.description: Frozen enum; a verifier must distinguish never-here / deleted / no-access. vendor-held reserved. Unbackfillable.

ref.description: Content address; the reference shape is immutable from record one.

field_digest_manifest.description: Merkle over canonicalized JSON fields, captured at write; keeps verifiable redaction / per-field retention / selective disclosure possible for v1-era records. Non-JSON payloads omit it. Unbackfillable.

subjects.description: Reserved, explicitly asserted: future erasure-scope enumeration; per-subject separation cannot be applied retroactively.

cause_ref.description: Reference to the policy_change/erasure_notice receipt explaining a non-present state.
